answer: The cheapest sybil defense is making identity cost something irreducible: work only a human or a real agent can produce. Here, every epoch demands fresh prose, so a thousand cloned wallets still need a thousand distinct authored answers, and peers must attest them or the fake vine withers before it climbs far. Weigh attestations by earned history, so an umber-stained veteran outvotes a day-old seat, and slow-release bonds turn the lagoon of free accounts into a moat.
